source.what: Rows that PostgreSQL 18.6 returned for the PostgreSQL bytes of each SQLite qualification cell of tests/test_sql_sqlite_native.py (its _LAW_CELLS, then the four statements of the emit_sqlite_single_file golden), each program with sqlite.table(" swapped for postgres.table(", on the fixture tables below (Phase78 S03, D78.08).
source.campaign: Preregistration v2.3, attempt 2 of the campaign, PASS exit 0; attempt 1 (v2.2, 2026-11-11T16:28:55Z) was void by a driver defect before any container existed. The campaign ended with this run.
source.container: --pull=never --network none, removed by its label after the run

regeneration: No command regenerates this file (golden-fixture policy). The replay driver wrote records.jsonl and result.json; each entry here copies, in manifest order, its record's sql_sha256, columns, type_oids and rows verbatim (a value is [type, text] as the replay driver wrote it: repr for int, float, str and bool, str for a decimal (OID 1700); null is NULL) and the judge's divergences; fixtures copy the manifest's tables. When an entry's PostgreSQL bytes, fixture rows, prewritten oracle or carriers change, test_each_postgres_replay_binds_the_bytes_it_ran in tests/test_sql_sqlite_native.py fails. Then the manifest is generated again from the tree, the changed or new entries run under a reviewed preregistration delta and D78.08's conditions, and a reviewed edit replaces only those entries and the source block; every unchanged entry keeps its saved rows (docs/development.md, SQLite target validation).

accounts.postgres_ddl: CREATE TABLE "accounts" ("id" bigint NOT NULL, "name" text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, "active" boolean NOT NULL, "score" double precision, "region" text COLLATE "C")

bool-pairs.postgres_ddl: CREATE TABLE "t" ("id" bigint NOT NULL, "b" boolean, "c" boolean)

rows.postgres_ddl: CREATE TABLE "t" ("id" bigint NOT NULL, "n" bigint, "s" text COLLATE "C", "b" boolean, "x" double precision)
